verdict: Design direction is valid; implementation acceptance remains pending.

required_explicit_constraints.requirement: Validate original strings before urlsplit side effects. Reject ASCII control/whitespace, empty query/fragment markers, percent escapes and noncanonical authority/path; do not silently strip or normalize. Root/trailing slash support must not loosen shared object-key safe_path.

required_explicit_constraints.topic: Exact per-group and per-round response shape
required_explicit_constraints.requirement: Tasks must be a list of dict rows and TotalCount a nonnegative true int, not bool/string/float; exact row count. Each queried group must account for exactly its queried IDs; validate per-row URL is expected and unconsumed before mapping. A full round covers each URL once and all IDs. Bound total rows by requested URL count. Foreign IDs from another valid group still reject.

required_explicit_constraints.topic: Submission ID envelope and write evidence
required_explicit_constraints.requirement: Each batch response has 1..batch-size canonical positive ASCII decimal IDs, unique within that response; cross-batch overlap is allowed and deduplicated in first-seen order. Record attempted before write. If any submission or query fails, no further submissions/replay/public progression, keep incomplete and known counts/IDs if available.

nonblocking_design_limits.detail: For 1000 unique IDs,20 writes and100 query groups per round: default3polls can require300 Describe calls; max10polls1000 calls. Per-request timeouts and poll count do not imply a short total deadline. Existing TEST ONLY driver outer bound must be explicit; adding a provider-wide deadline is a separately scoped decision.

nonblocking_design_limits.topic: Aggregated extra URLs and eventual visibility
nonblocking_design_limits.detail: Strict equality intentionally rejects extra/missing rows, including possible same-domain same-second foreign submissions or incomplete visibility. This stops success claims but does not undo the already accepted refresh or prove production availability.
One supplied observed4row task supports repeated TaskId row shape, not every CDN response. No production flags may become true and no broad all-task listing/fallback/implicit retry is justified.
